repos.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持在 WhatsApp、Telegram、Slack 等主流通讯平台运行，兼容 macOS/iOS/Android 系统，具备语音交互与实时画布渲染能力。其网关为控制平面，核心产品是本地部署的个性化助手，强调隐私、速度与持续在线体验。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that runs on your own devices across any OS and platform. It integrates with messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack, supports voice interaction, live canvas rendering, and prioritizes local deployment for privacy, speed, and always-on personal assistance.

repos.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

repos.description: Agents that use the browser.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: ChatGPT 中文调教指南。各种场景使用指南。学习怎么让它听你的话。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供全面的 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，涵盖学术论文、创意写作、商业文案、翻译、数据分析等 20+ 应用场景，帮助用户掌握提示词技巧，让 AI 高效完成各类任务，提升工作效率与内容质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive guide to prompting ChatGPT in Chinese, covering over 20 use cases including academic writing, creative content, business communication, translation, and data analysis. It empowers users to master prompt engineering and leverage AI for enhanced productivity and content quality.

repos.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么
repos.summary_zh: 中国独立开发者项目列表聚合了2026年2月最新上线的创新产品，涵盖AI语音助手、投资理财工具、打字练习平台、音乐生成、简历优化、浏览器插件等多个领域。项目以网站或App形式呈现，强调实用性与用户体验，如智能语音朗读、美股A股基金定投计算、AI音乐创作等，展现了中国独立开发者在AI应用与垂直场景工具上的活跃创新。
repos.summary_en: This repo aggregates innovative projects by Chinese indie developers launched in February 2026, including AI voice assistants, investment calculators, typing trainers, music generation tools, resume optimizers, and browser extensions. All projects are web or app-based, emphasizing practicality and user experience, such as intelligent text-to-speech, stock/fund investment analysis, AI-powered songwriting, and productivity tools, showcasing active innovation in AI applications and niche utility apps.

repos.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

repos.description: Open-source personal AI assistant & Agent Harness. Plans tasks, runs tools and skills, self-evolves with memory and knowledge. Multi-agent, multi-model, multi-channel. Lightweight, extensible, one-line install.
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级 AI 助理，具备自主任务规划、长期记忆、个人知识库和技能系统能力。支持多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件），兼容 OpenAI、Claude、DeepSeek 等主流模型，可接入微信、飞书、钉钉等多平台，提供 CLI 管理和 Web 控制台，适用于个人 AI 助理和企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, featuring autonomous task planning, long-term memory, personal knowledge base, and skill system. It supports multimodal interactions (text/voice/image/file), integrates with OpenAI/Claude/DeepSeek and other mainstream models, connects to WeChat/Lark/DingTalk and other platforms via CLI/Web console, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.summary_zh: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
repos.summary_en: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
repos.summary_en: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

repos.description: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
repos.summary_zh: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
repos.summary_zh: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
repos.summary_en: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板通过Claude Code实现网页逆向工程，利用Chrome MCP自动提取设计元素与组件规格，并行构建像素级复刻站点。支持多页面、响应式交互还原及资产下载，基于Next.js 16+shadcn/ui技术栈，提供自动化开发流水线。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered website cloning template that reverse-engineers any site using Claude Code and Chrome MCP. It extracts design tokens, generates component specs, and rebuilds pages pixel-perfect via parallel builder agents in isolated git worktrees. Built with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS v4.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持本地或云端部署，数据完全自主可控。内置日程管理、文档处理等技能，支持多智能体协作与自定义扩展，兼容多种聊天平台，易于安装与集成。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant that can be deployed locally or in the cloud, ensuring full data control. It features built-in skills like scheduling and document processing, supports multi-agent collaboration and extensible custom skills, and integrates with multiple chat platforms.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个通用 CLI 中枢与 AI 原生运行时，可将任意网站、Electron 应用或本地工具转换为标准化命令行接口。支持浏览器自动化、70+ 内置站点适配器（如 Bilibili、知乎等）、AI 智能体无缝集成，具备反检测机制与零 LLM 成本运行特性。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a universal CLI hub and AI-native runtime that transforms websites, Electron apps, and local tools into deterministic command-line interfaces. It features browser automation, 70+ built-in site adapters (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu), anti-detection measures, and seamless AI agent integration with zero LLM token consumption.

repos.description: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
repos.summary_zh: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
repos.summary_en: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

repos.description: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
repos.summary_zh: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
repos.summary_en: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

repos.description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
repos.summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: OpenCodex 是一款通用的本地代理工具，旨在打破 OpenAI Codex 与 Claude Code 对特定大模型的限制。它通过将 Codex 的 Responses API 转换为任意 LLM 提供商（如 Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Ollama 等）的接口，实现无缝切换。该工具支持流式传输、工具调用及多模态输入，并内置了 ChatGPT 账号池管理功能，可自动进行配额刷新与负载均衡，确保开发流程的连续性。
repos.summary_en: OpenCodex is a universal local proxy that eliminates vendor lock-in for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code. It translates Codex's Responses API into various LLM provider formats (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, etc.), enabling seamless model switching. Supporting streaming, tool calls, and multimodal inputs, it also features a ChatGPT account pool manager for automatic quota refreshing and load balancing to ensure uninterrupted development workflows.

repos.description: Make Any Website & Tool Your CLI. A universal CLI Hub and AI-native runtime. Transform any website, Electron app, or local binary into a standardized command-line interface. Built for AI Agents to discover, learn, and execute tools seamlessly via a unified AGENT.md integration.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个强大的 AI 原生浏览器自动化工具，可将任意网站或 Electron 应用转换为命令行接口。它支持会话复用、AI 驱动的发现与合成，提供零风险的数据提取和跨平台自动化能力，适用于 Bilibili、知乎、小红书等主流平台。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a powerful, AI-native browser automation tool that turns any website or Electron app into a CLI. It enables seamless web data extraction and automation with session reuse, AI-powered discovery, and dynamic adapter loading, supporting platforms like Bilibili, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu.

repos.description: ✍ WeChat Markdown Editor | 一款高度简洁的微信 Markdown 编辑器：支持 Markdown 语法、自定义主题样式、内容管理、多图床、AI 助手等特性
repos.summary_zh: Doocs MD 是一款专为微信设计的简洁 Markdown 编辑器，支持完整 Markdown 语法、数学公式、Mermaid 图表、PlantUML 和 Ruby 注音，集成多图床上传与主流 AI 助手，提供自定义主题与本地草稿管理，实现 Markdown 内容一键渲染为美观微信图文。
repos.summary_en: Doocs MD is a minimalist Markdown editor tailored for WeChat, supporting full Markdown syntax, math formulas, Mermaid charts, PlantUML, Ruby annotations, multi-image hosting, and AI assistants. It enables instant rendering of Markdown into visually appealing WeChat articles with customizable themes and local draft management.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server 是一款基于 Chrome 扩展的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，将浏览器功能暴露给 Claude 等 AI 助手，实现复杂浏览器自动化、内容分析与语义搜索。它直接利用用户现有 Chrome 环境，保留登录状态与配置，支持 20+ 工具，提供本地流式 HTTP 通信，并集成 SIMD 加速的向量数据库，实现智能跨标签页语义检索。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex automation, content analysis, and semantic search. It leverages your existing Chrome browser with preserved login states and settings, supports 20+ tools, offers local streamable HTTP communication, and features SIMD-accelerated vector database for intelligent tab content discovery.

repos.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
repos.summary_zh: Ekko Studio 是一款本地优先的 AI 工作空间，支持多代理实时协作、可视化工作流构建与编码任务。集成 Hermes、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理运行时，提供桌面端、Web 控制台与 Docker 部署方案，适用于开发者与团队的高效 AI 协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace supporting multi-agent collaboration, visual workflow building, and coding tasks. It integrates Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and other mainstream AI agent runtimes, offering desktop app, web console and Docker deployment options for developer and team efficiency.

repos.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Studio 是 Hermes Agent 的全功能本地控制平面，提供跨平台 AI 聊天、会话管理、定时任务与用量分析。支持 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等 8 大平台统一配置，内置文件浏览器、Web 终端、语音交互与编码代理运行器。以桌面应用、npm CLI 和 Docker 镜像三种形式分发，所有数据本地存储于 SQLite，确保隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive local control plane for Hermes Agent, delivering multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It unifies configuration across 8 platforms including Telegram, Discord, and Slack, with built-in file browsing, web terminal, voice I/O, and coding agent runners. Distributed as a desktop app, npm CLI package, and Docker image, all data stays local via SQLite storage.

repos.description: Bytebot is a self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks through natural language commands, operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment.
repos.summary_zh: Bytebot 是一个自托管的开源 AI 桌面代理，通过自然语言指令自动化计算机任务。它运行在容器化的 Linux 桌面环境中，拥有完整的虚拟桌面，可自主使用各类应用程序、处理文件、登录网站、读取文档并执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，真正实现 AI 拥有独立计算机的自主操作能力。
repos.summary_en: Bytebot is an open-source, self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks via natural language commands. Operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment, it provides a full virtual desktop where it can use any application, manage files, authenticate on websites, process documents, and execute complex multi-step workflows with complete autonomy.

repos.description: GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code. Comprehensive AI search optimization for any website — citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority, schema markup, platform-specific optimization, and PDF reports.  If you want learn how to sell this to real businesses, check out the skool community
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 GEO-first SEO 技能，提供全面的 AI 搜索引擎优化服务，包括内容可引用性评分、AI 爬虫分析、品牌权威性评估、结构化数据生成及跨平台优化，支持 PDF 报告输出，助力企业抢占 AI 流量入口。
repos.summary_en: A GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code that delivers comprehensive AI search optimization, including citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority assessment, schema markup generation, and platform-specific tuning, with professional PDF reporting capabilities to capture high-converting AI-driven traffic.

repos.description: chat log tool, easily use your own chat data. 聊天记录工具，轻松使用自己的聊天数据
repos.summary_zh: chatlog 是一款聊天记录工具，旨在帮助用户轻松管理和使用自己的聊天数据。由于微信官方函件指出其核心功能存在合规风险，项目于2025年10月20日被主动移除，仅保留说明文件。用户无法再获取代码或支持，建议删除本地副本以规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: Chatlog was a chat log tool designed to help users easily manage and utilize their own chat data. Due to compliance risks identified in an official letter from WeChat, the project was voluntarily removed on October 20, 2025. Only this notice remains; no code, binaries, or support are available. Users are advised to delete any local copies to avoid legal issues.

repos.description: LangChain 的中文入门教程
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 中文入门教程系统讲解大模型应用开发框架，涵盖文档加载、文本分割、向量存储、Chain 链与 Agent 代理等核心概念，提供 OpenAI API 集成、PDF/YouTube 数据处理等实战案例，配套 GitBook 与 Colab 代码，适合 AI 开发者快速上手构建智能应用。
repos.summary_en: This comprehensive LangChain Chinese tutorial covers core concepts like document loading, text splitting, vectorstores, chains, and agents for building LLM-powered applications. It includes practical examples with OpenAI integration, PDF/YouTube data processing, and provides GitBook and Colab code resources for developers to quickly build AI applications.

repos.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
repos.summary_zh: Octop 是腾讯开源的自托管多用户 AI 助手，采用多 Agent 架构支持团队协作与个人使用。集成专家库、RAG 知识库、MCP/OAuth 连接器生态，支持 MBTI 人格模板、IDE 集成与浏览器自动化，JWT 隔离保障数据隐私本地化运行。
repos.summary_en: Octop is Tencent's open-source self-hosted multi-user AI assistant featuring a multi-agent architecture for team and personal collaboration. Integrates expert libraries, RAG knowledge base, MCP/OAuth connectors, MBTI personas, IDE integration and browser automation, with JWT isolation ensuring local privacy.

repos.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Web UI 是一个功能完整的 Hermes Agent 管理仪表盘，支持多平台 AI 聊天会话管理、实时消息流、定时任务调度、使用量分析与成本追踪，以及 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等八种通信渠道的统一配置，提供本地 SQLite 会话存储与全局搜索能力。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Web UI is a full-featured dashboard for managing the Hermes Agent, offering multi-platform AI chat session control, real-time streaming, scheduled cron jobs, usage analytics with cost tracking, and unified configuration for 8 communication channels including Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

repos.description: The chat decision assistant: before you reply, Jev reads the chat, judges intent and risk, and drafts replies you fill in with one tap. You press send. Android · Windows · macOS · iOS | 聊天辅助决策工具：先看懂对方再回复，发不发由你。
repos.summary_zh: Jev 聊天助手是一款装在手机上的对话副驾，支持微信/QQ/X/飞书等主流聊天应用。通过系统无障碍服务非侵入式读取屏幕内容，结合 AI 分析对方意图与危险等级，生成 3 条候选回复一键填入输入框，发送权始终由用户掌控，隐私安全、接口可配。
repos.summary_en: Jev Chat Assistant is a mobile AI chat co-pilot supporting WeChat, QQ, X, and Feishu. Using Android accessibility service for non-invasive screen reading, it analyzes intent and risk level, generates three candidate replies for one-tap input, while keeping sending control and privacy fully in user's hands with customizable API endpoints.

repos.description: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作辅助系统，通过双 Agent 架构和六维审查机制解决 AI 写作中的遗忘与幻觉问题，支持 200 万字级连载创作，集成 RAG 检索、创意约束系统和追读力机制，确保叙事连贯性与读者粘性。
repos.summary_en: A long-form webnovel writing assistant built on Claude Code, utilizing dual-agent architecture and six-dimensional review mechanisms to address AI writing issues like forgetting and hallucination, supporting serialized creation up to 2 million words with RAG retrieval, creative constraint systems, and reader engagement mechanics.

repos.description: FunASR-powered video transcription, subtitle generation, and LLM-assisted clipping tool with a local Gradio UI.
repos.summary_zh: FunClip 是一款开源、精准且易用的视频语音识别与剪辑工具，集成阿里巴巴通义语音实验室开源的 FunASR Paraformer 系列模型，支持中文及英文语音识别，具备热词定制、说话人分离、多段自由剪辑等功能，并引入 LLM 智能剪辑能力，用户可通过 Gradio 界面快速生成精准视频片段与字幕。
repos.summary_en: FunClip is an open-source, accurate, and user-friendly video speech recognition and clipping tool. It leverages Alibaba's FunASR Paraformer models for ASR, supports Chinese and English, enables hotword customization, speaker separation, multi-segment clipping, and integrates LLM-based AI clipping via Qwen/GPT series models with customizable prompts for intelligent video editing.

repos.description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
repos.summary_zh: DeepChat 是一个功能丰富的开源 AI 智能体平台，统一整合模型、工具和智能体，支持多 LLM 对话、MCP 工具调用和 ACP 智能体集成，提供强大的桌面端 AI 助手体验。
repos.summary_en: DeepChat is a powerful open-source AI agent platform that unifies models, tools, and agents, offering multi-LLM chat, MCP tool calling, and ACP agent integration for seamless desktop AI assistance.

repos.description: 💬 Unofficial WeChat client built with React, MobX and Electron.
repos.summary_zh: weweChat 是基于 React、MobX 和 Electron 开发的非官方微信客户端，支持桌面端多平台运行，具备消息防撤回、桌面通知、键盘快捷键、拖拽发送文件、批量消息发送等实用功能，界面现代化且兼容 macOS 窗口毛玻璃效果。
repos.summary_en: weweChat is an unofficial WeChat desktop client built with React, MobX, and Electron. It supports desktop notifications, message recall blocking, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop file sending, and batch messaging, offering a modern interface with macOS vibrancy effects.

repos.description: ⚡️next-generation personal AI assistant powered by LLM, RAG and agent loops, supporting computer-use, browser-use and coding agent, demo: https://demo.openagentai.org
repos.summary_zh: OpenAgent 是一款开源的企业级 AI 知识库与智能体管理平台，支持 MCP/A2A 协议，集成 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama 等主流大模型，提供带单点登录的管理后台和用户界面，适用于构建私有化 AI 应用与多智能体协作系统。
repos.summary_en: OpenAgent is an open-source enterprise-grade AI knowledge base and agent management platform supporting MCP/A2A protocols. It integrates major LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Llama, offering admin UI, user management, and SSO for secure, scalable AI application deployment.

repos.description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
repos.summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

repos.description: 🚀 KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API【特长：长文本解读整理】，支持高速流式输出、智能体对话、联网搜索、探索版、K1思考模型、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索、智能体对话、长文档解读及图像解析，零配置部署，兼容ChatGPT接口，支持多路token轮询与自动会话清理，仅供测试用途。
repos.summary_en: KIMI AI long-text LLM reverse API supporting high-speed streaming, multi-turn dialogue, web search, agent conversations, document interpretation, and image parsing. Zero-config deployment, ChatGPT-compatible interface, multi-token support, and automatic session cleanup. For testing only.

repos.description: ⚡️AI Cloud OS: Open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP (model-context-protocol)/A2A (agent-to-agent) management platform with admin UI, user management and Single-Sign-On⚡️, supports ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, HuggingFace, etc., chat bot demo: https://ai.casibase.com, admin UI demo: https://ai-admin.casibase.com
repos.summary_zh: Casibase 是一个开源企业级 AI 知识库与 MCP/A2A 管理平台，提供管理员界面、用户管理及单点登录功能，支持 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama、Ollama 等多种模型，具备完整的知识库管理、智能对话和 Agent 协作能力。
repos.summary_en: Casibase is an open-source enterprise-level AI knowledge base and MCP/A2A management platform featuring admin UI, user management, and SSO, supporting ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, Ollama, and more, with full knowledge management and agent collaboration capabilities.

repos.description: 让 AI 写的中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话。通用创作与改稿 Skill，开箱即用。
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 写的中文摆脱模型腔，读起来像具体的人在说话。提供开箱即用的写作 Skill，覆盖知乎、公众号、博客、小说等多种场景，内置事实核查、逻辑推进与中文韵律三重把关，附检测脚本与蒸馏版提示词。
repos.summary_en: Eliminates AI-generated Chinese stiffness, making outputs read like a real person speaking. Provides a ready-to-use writing Skill for Zhihu, WeChat articles, blogs, fiction and more, with built-in fact-checking, logical progression and Chinese rhythm controls, plus a detection script and distilled prompt version.

repos.description: 面向 AI Agent 的微信公众号创作与发布 CLI：Markdown 排版、AI 配图、预览与草稿创建；支持由浏览器 Agent 保存知乎、CSDN、头条未发布草稿。
repos.summary_zh: md2wechat 是一款专为 AI 时代设计的公众号创作工具，支持用 Markdown 编写文章并一键转换为精美排版，自动上传至微信草稿箱。提供 43 个高级排版模块、40+ 专业主题、AI 配图及批量发布功能，全流程 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code 等智能体，让公众号写作高效如发朋友圈。
repos.summary_en: md2wechat is an AI-native WeChat article creation tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted posts and auto-uploads to the draft box. It offers 43 advanced layout modules, 40+ professional themes, AI image generation, and batch publishing via CLI, with native support for agents like Claude Code.

repos.description: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，实时更新，导出和修改聊天记录，朋友圈，收藏，自动回复等大量便捷功能
repos.summary_zh: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
repos.summary_en: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

repos.description: Auto-register & manage accounts for ChatGPT, Cursor, Kiro, Grok, Windsurf, Trae & 13+ AI platforms · Protocol/browser dual-mode · Plugin-based · One-click Mac/Windows desktop app
repos.summary_zh: Any Auto Register 是一个多平台账号自动注册与管理系统，支持 Trae.ai、Tavily、Cursor 等主流 AI 平台。采用 FastAPI + React 架构，具备插件化扩展能力，集成邮箱服务（MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail）、验证码识别（YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox）及代理池管理功能，提供实时日志推送的 Web UI 界面。
repos.summary_en: Any Auto Register is a multi-platform account auto-registration and management system supporting major AI platforms like Trae.ai, Tavily, and Cursor. Built with FastAPI + React, it features plugin-based extensibility, integrated mailbox services (MoeMail/Laoudo/DuckMail), captcha solving (YesCaptcha/2Captcha/Camoufox), proxy pool management, and real-time log streaming via SSE to a web UI.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是冬瓜关于 Pi-Agent SDK 的深度学习笔记，系统拆解了生产级 AI Agent 运行时的核心架构。教程涵盖 Agent Loop、工具系统、事件驱动等 10 大模块，通过 TypeScript 与 Python 双语言对照，深入剖析了 Agent SDK 的设计取舍与源码实现，适合希望构建或理解 Agent 底层逻辑的开发者。
repos.summary_en: A deep-dive tutorial repository on the Pi-Agent SDK, systematically deconstructing the core architecture of production-grade AI Agent runtimes. Covering 10 modules including Agent Loop, tool systems, and event-driven design, it provides TypeScript and Python dual-language comparisons to analyze the source code and design trade-offs of Agent SDKs for developers.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
repos.summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
repos.summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

repos.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
repos.summary_zh: Cindy 是一款开源、开箱即用的跨平台 AI Agent 客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex 等多种模型编排。它可在本地运行，集成文件系统访问、浏览器自动化和 MCP 协议，实现跨设备的任务编排与自动化执行。
repos.summary_en: Cindy is an open-source, out-of-the-box AI agent client supporting Claude Code and Codex orchestration. It runs locally with file system access, browser automation, and MCP protocol integration for cross-device task orchestration and automated execution.

repos.description: 🚀 DeepSeek-V3 & R1大模型逆向API【特长：良心厂商】（官方贼便宜，建议直接走官方），支持高速流式输出、多轮对话，联网搜索，R1深度思考，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供 DeepSeek-V3 和 R1 大模型的逆向 API 接口，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索及深度思考功能，兼容 ChatGPT 接口标准，支持零配置部署与多账号 token 负载均衡，仅限个人测试使用，商用请转官方平台。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for DeepSeek-V3 and R1 models, featuring high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversations, web search, and deep reasoning. It is fully compatible with ChatGPT's API interface, supports zero-configuration deployment and multi-token load balancing, intended only for personal testing, commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: Bridge Claude Code / Codex to IM platforms — chat with AI coding agents from Telegram, Discord, or Feishu/Lark.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-to-IM Skill 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，将 Claude Code / Codex 与 Telegram、Discord、飞书/Lark 或 QQ 等即时通讯平台桥接，实现通过 IM 聊天与 AI 编程代理交互。支持权限控制、流式响应预览、会话持久化，无需编码即可快速部署。
repos.summary_en: Claude-to-IM Skill is a lightweight CLI tool that bridges Claude Code/Codex with IM platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, and QQ. It enables chatting with AI coding agents directly from your chats, featuring permission control, streaming previews, session persistence, and zero-code setup.

repos.description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
repos.summary_zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，完整实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，支持 MacOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 和 Web 多端运行。提供本地存储、数据同步、LaTeX 渲染、Mermaid 图表生成、HTML 预览及多 LLM 模型接入等功能，适用于智能对话与工具集成场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), supporting MacOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and Web. It offers local storage, data sync, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagram generation, HTML preview, and multi-LLM provider integration for intelligent conversations and tool workflows.

repos.description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.description: ClawGod is a runtime patch applied to the official Claude Code. It continues to be supported with each version update.
repos.summary_zh: ClawGod 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的运行时补丁工具，通过动态注入方式解锁官方版本限制的功能，包括隐藏命令、多智能体协作、屏幕控制等。支持跨平台自动更新与卸载，绿色图标标识已打补丁状态，显著提升开发效率与功能自由度。
repos.summary_en: ClawGod is a runtime patch for Claude Code that unlocks restricted features like hidden commands, multi-agent collaboration, and computer use without Pro subscription. It auto-reapplies patches after updates, uses green branding to indicate patched status, and supports cross-platform installation with one-line scripts.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task
repos.summary_zh: WorkAny 是一款桌面 AI 智能体应用，通过自然语言指令执行复杂任务，支持实时代码生成、工具调用和沙箱环境运行。基于 Claude Agent SDK 构建，集成 MCP 协议与多模型供应商，提供文件管理、文档/网页/表格/幻灯片生成等全场景能力，适用于自动化办公与软件开发。
repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: Awesome AI GPTs, OpenAI GPTs, GPT-4, ChatGPT, GPTs, Prompts, plugins, Prompts leaking
repos.summary_zh: Awesome AI GPTs 是一个精选的 OpenAI GPTs 资源库，涵盖提示词工程、内容创作、编程辅助、数据分析等场景。项目提供热门 GPTs 推荐、插件安装指南、知识库构建工具及安全防护方案，助力用户高效利用 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Awesome AI GPTs is a curated collection of OpenAI GPTs resources, covering prompt engineering, content creation, coding assistance, and data analysis. It offers hot GPTs recommendations, plugin installation guides, knowledge base tools, and security solutions to enhance AI utilization.

repos.description: 🚀 即梦3.0逆向API【特长：图像生成顶流】，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 即梦3.0逆向API服务，提供零配置部署的图像生成能力，支持多路token并发，兼容OpenAI接口标准，每日免费66次生成额度，适用于个人测试与学习用途。
repos.summary_en: Jimeng AI Free API service enables zero-configuration deployment of image generation via reverse-engineered API, supporting multiple tokens and OpenAI-compatible interface, offering 66 daily free generations for testing purposes.

repos.summary_zh: VSC社区维护的Codex Skills集合，聚焦AIGC创作与视觉工作流。提供提示词工程、稀有风格探索、东方神话插画、抓拍人像摄影及虚拟Vlog生成等技能封装，支持一键安装至Codex并通过$skill-name调用，辅助创作者高效复用创意方法与管理生成资产。
repos.summary_en: A community-maintained collection of Codex Skills focused on AIGC creation and visual workflows. Covers prompt engineering, rare style exploration, Eastern mythology illustration, candid photography prompts, and virtual vlog generation. Skills are installed into Codex and invoked via $skill-name for efficient creative reuse and asset management.

repos.summary_zh: Jev 聊天助手是一款 Android 对话副驾应用，通过无障碍服务读取微信/QQ/X/飞书等聊天内容，结合 TypeSafe Jev 判断对方意图与危险等级，并用 LLM 生成 3 条候选回复，一键填入输入框。不自动发送，隐私本地存储，支持多平台适配扩展。
repos.summary_en: Jev Chat Assistant is an AI conversation co-pilot for Android. It reads chat content across WeChat, QQ, X, and Feishu via accessibility services, analyzes intent and risk levels using TypeSafe Jev, generates 3 candidate replies with LLM, and fills them into the input box with one tap. Non-invasive, privacy-first, extensible multi-platform design.

repos.description: 完全运行于 Cloudflare Worker的现代聊天系统：实时通信、Telegram 双向桥接、消息与文件加密 A modern, self-hosted team chat built on Cloudflare — realtime messaging, Telegram bridge, encrypted messages & files, and WebMCP. |
repos.summary_zh: EdgeChat 是基于 Cloudflare 全家桶构建的零运维团队聊天系统，支持公开/私有群组、私信与实时消息通信。特色功能为 Telegram 双向消息桥接，Bot 驱动跨平台无缝同步。前端采用 Vue 3 + Hono，Durable Objects 承载 WebSocket 连接，AES-256-GCM 加密保障数据安全，在免费额度内即可落地企业级 IM。
repos.summary_en: EdgeChat is a zero-infrastructure team chat system built on Cloudflare ecosystem, supporting public/private groups, DMs, and real-time messaging. Its standout feature is bidirectional Telegram bridge via Bot for seamless cross-platform sync. Powered by Vue 3 + Hono frontend, Durable Objects for WebSocket, and AES-256-GCM encryption, it delivers enterprise-grade IM within Cloudflare's free tier.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款开源的网站目录导航系统，支持一键部署个人导航站点。内置基于 Playwright/Jina/OpenAI 的自动网站收录功能，集成 SEO 优化、多语言国际化、暗黑/亮色主题切换，并提供 MinIO/AWS S3/腾讯云 COS 多种图片存储方案，适合快速搭建个性化网站导航平台。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is an open-source website directory/navigation system enabling one-click deployment of personal navigation sites. It features automatic site crawling via Playwright/Jina/OpenAI, integrated SEO optimization, multilingual i18n, dark/light theme toggle, and multiple image storage options including MinIO, AWS S3, and Tencent Cloud COS — ideal for quickly building personalized navigation platforms.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
repos.summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
repos.summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

repos.description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: Any Agent × Any Provider × Anywhere. Connect Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat — with any LLM provider.
repos.summary_zh: GolemBot 是一个革命性工具，允许将 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex 等任意 AI 编程代理与任何 LLM 提供商集成，并部署到即时通讯（IM）、HTTP 接口或自有产品中。它通过单一配置实现跨平台运行，无需修改代码或依赖特定 AI 框架，支持 13,000+ OpenClaw 社区技能，极大扩展了 AI 代理的应用场景。
repos.summary_en: GolemBot enables running any coding agent (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) with any LLM provider and deploying it to IM platforms, HTTP endpoints, or custom products. It requires zero code changes, supports 13,000+ OpenClaw community skills, and integrates seamlessly via configuration—no AI framework dependency.

repos.description: ChatGPT&AIGC资料汇总，包含前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目和商业变现等
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为ChatGPT与AIGC领域的综合性资料库，涵盖前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目与商业变现路径，提供注册升级指南及深度行业研报，助力开发者与从业者快速掌握AI技术生态与落地场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates comprehensive resources on ChatGPT and AIGC, including cutting-edge news, application cases, technical tutorials, open-source projects, and monetization strategies. It provides registration/guide tutorials and in-depth industry reports to help developers and professionals quickly master the AI technology ecosystem and real-world applications.

repos.description: 影子作家 · 为角色建立可复用的写作与语言特征模型，让 AI 稳定地「像某个人」说话。Python / Agent Skill 双形态。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目'ghostwriter'（影子作家）提供多来源语言特征JSON数据集，涵盖微博、文学影视角色及历史人物，支持非商业用途研究。采用CC BY-NC-ND 4.0许可，结合长上下文大模型可显著提升文本生成风格拟合度，适用于AI角色模拟与语言分析。
repos.summary_en: The 'ghostwriter' project provides structured linguistic feature datasets in JSON format, covering sources like Weibo, literary characters, and historical figures. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for non-commercial use, it enhances AI text generation when combined with large language models featuring long context capabilities, ideal for character simulation and stylistic analysis.

repos.description: Full-featured GUI for Claude Code CLI in VS Code — Windows (no WSL) & macOS. Third-party API, MCP plugins, Skills, Hooks, real-time token tracking. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

repos.description: Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies, and AI-search growth teams.
repos.summary_zh: SEO GEO Audit 是一个统一的网站审计框架，专为品牌、SaaS团队、SEO运营者、代理机构和AI搜索增长团队设计。它将技术健康度、内容质量、EEAT（经验、专业性、权威性、可信度）、实体信号和AI可见性整合为可执行决策框架，解决传统SEO检查表无法回答的‘网站是否真正准备好在搜索引擎和AI驱动发现中获胜’的核心问题。
repos.summary_en: SEO GEO Audit is a unified audit framework for teams needing more than basic technical SEO checks. It diagnoses whether a website is technically sound, structurally clear, trustworthy, AI-packaged, externally visible, and aligned with multiple AI platforms. Instead of fragmented findings, it delivers a prioritized decision framework covering technical health, content quality, EEAT, entity signals, authority, and off-site visibility to answer the critical question: Is this site ready to win in both search engines and AI-driven discovery?

repos.description: Professional SEO and GEO audit workflows for brands, SaaS teams, SEO operators, agencies, and AI-search growth teams.
repos.summary_zh: SEO GEO Audit 是一个统一的审计框架，专为品牌、SaaS团队、SEO运营者、代理机构和AI搜索增长团队设计。它将技术健康度、内容质量、信任背书、外部平台可见性及AI适配性整合为可执行的决策体系，帮助判断网站是否真正具备在搜索引擎和AI驱动发现中获胜的能力。
repos.summary_en: SEO GEO Audit is a unified audit framework for teams needing more than technical SEO checks. It evaluates whether a website is technically sound, structurally clear, trustworthy, AI-ready, externally visible, and aligned across platforms—turning fragmented findings into a prioritized executive decision system.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: A lightweight, context-aware AI assistant designed specifically for macOS
repos.summary_zh: Sidey 是一款专为 macOS 打造的轻量级、上下文感知 AI 助手。它以菜单栏弹出窗口和悬浮窗伴侣形式快速调用，支持选中文本即时处理、应用感知提示词推荐、多应用专属 AI 人格自动创建，并深度集成 Safari 与 Finder。内置公共 AI 服务无需 API Key，支持 Markdown 渲染、iCloud 同步与全局热键，实现无缝跨应用智能辅助。
repos.summary_en: Sidey is a lightweight, context-aware AI assistant built exclusively for macOS. It launches instantly from the menu bar or as a window-docked companion, offering selection-based text processing, app-aware prompt suggestions, and auto-generated AI personas per application. With deep Safari and Finder integration, built-in public AI service, Markdown rendering, iCloud sync, and global hotkeys, Sidey delivers seamless cross-app intelligent assistance without disrupting your workflow.
